boundary: The topology maps exactly to a demonstrated dual-rail transmon interaction pattern, but 87-transmon fabrication, parallel-coupler crosstalk, calibration, and 28-qubit performance are not demonstrated. Independent-gate products are scaling diagnostics, not experimental predictions.

platform_reference.architecture: two tunable transmons per logical dual-rail qubit, associated ancilla for erasure detection, tunable inter-logical coupler generating logical XX / sqrt(iSWAP)

w33_mapping.logical_graph: binary tree on 28 payload nodes plus clock attached to payload root
